tools.name: social-content_repurpose
tools.description: Shorten supplied text to a documented character limit only when the caller names a target platform. No words are added and nothing is published. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/social-content/repurpose. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "social-content" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: social-content_duplicate-detect · Private data: social-content_duplicate-detect · Public sink: social-content_post-performance-analyze, social-content_calendar-generate, social-content_repurpose, social-content_hashtag-analyze, social-content_comment-classify, social-content_engagement-anomaly-detect, social-content_duplicate-detect, social-content_account-performance-report · Destructive: social-content_post-performance-analyze, social-content_calendar-generate, social-content_repurpose, social-content_hashtag-analyze, social-content_comment-classify, social-content_engagement-anomaly-detect, social-content_duplicate-detect, social-content_account-performance-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: social-content_duplicate-detect · Private data: social-content_duplicate-detect · Public sink: social-content_post-performance-analyze, social-content_calendar-generate, social-content_repurpose, social-content_hashtag-analyze, social-content_comment-classify, social-content_engagement-anomaly-detect, social-content_duplicate-detect, social-content_account-performance-report · Destructive: social-content_post-performance-analyze, social-content_calendar-generate, social-content_repurpose, social-content_hashtag-analyze, social-content_comment-classify, social-content_engagement-anomaly-detect, social-content_duplicate-detect, social-content_account-performance-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
